sourceSentences: While Renekton has at least 50 Fury, his next basic ability, excluding Slice and Dice, consumes 50 Fury to become empowered with an additional effect.
Renekton generates 50% bonus Fury from all sources while below 50% of his maximum health.
Reign of Anger Bonus: Dice, the recast, deals bonus physical damage and inflicts armor reduction to enemies hit for 4 seconds.

Renekton instead strikes 3 times, completely destroying damage-mitigating shields on the target upon the first strike if they are not a monster, as well as increasing the stun duration to 1.5 seconds.
If the target becomes untargetable or dies during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
Renekton cannot basic attack nor cast Slice and Dice or Dominus for 0.25 seconds after Cull the Meek's activation.
After Ruthless Predator's standard and empowered attack cast time, Renekton cannot move nor cast Cull the Meek or Slice and Dice for. Casting Dominus ends this lockout prematurely.
Renekton retains Dominus' bonus health (if not over his normal maximum) once the duration ends.
For combos, your go-to is to E into an attack and W. Attack into Q before attacking into your second E.
Your all-in combo is to attack into W before attacking into E. Once more, attack into Q before attacking into your second E. And this combo also works well if you alt after using W.
he generates bonus fury when below half health.
So, what I like to practice is auto canceling with my Q.
Next, I like to practice um R canceling. Well, my well, W canceling with my R.
Right? So, auto W R. Right, cool. And after that, I like to practice auto W R Q cuz you could actually cancel your R animation with your Q.
So, that looks like flash auto W. So, flash auto W R Q auto E.
(Misanthiel, auto-translated from French) We're going to start very simply with the animation cancel, perhaps the best known of Renekton, which is the W R.
(Misanthiel, auto-translated) Here I'm going to put autoattack then E2 which consumes fury.
(Misanthiel, auto-translated) if you need to stop locking on a target, or possibly break a big shield, you'll use the improved W.
(Misanthiel, auto-translated) When there's been about a quarter of a second of your autoattack animation, you can start to launch the Q, otherwise you cancel it.
